issues.detail: The Hebrew says the queen entered the banquet house 'in response to the words of the king and his nobles' (לָקֳבֵל מִלֵּי מַלְכָּא וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי לְבֵית מִשְׁתְּיָא עַלַּת). The Chinese reverses the subject/object: it says 'the queen... from the banquet house came to the queen' (從筵席的家起身，來到王后面前), which misidentifies who enters and who is addressed. The Hebrew has the queen entering the banquet house and speaking to the king; the Chinese has someone coming from the banquet house to the queen, and the queen speaking. This changes who is doing what to whom.
